# CI, build and infrastructure (rebuild policy)

- Changes here need the user's go-ahead before they are committed: they affect everyone and every environment.
- Never weaken a required check (removing a step, `continue-on-error`, skipping tests or lint) to get green.
- CI runs the same commands as local work (`.rebuild/commands.json`). Change a command there and regenerate the workflow, rather than editing steps so they drift from local runs.
- Pin actions and images to a version; never pass secrets through command-line arguments or logs.
